title.en: An Act Authorizing Provinces and Municipalities to Purchase and Own Shares of stock of the Philippine National Bank.

text.en:
The regular and special provinces, municipalities, and municipal districts are hereby authorized
to purchase and own shares of stock of the Philippine National Bank, subject to the approval of the Secretary
of the Interior.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 19, 1921.
